advisory: Voices of the Void: from the main menu this tab opens levels through the game's own Sandbox screen, which is what makes dev/sandbox/tutorial maps load. From inside a level a plain open is used and many of those maps freeze (endless cube props), so return to the main menu first.

unsafe_origins.note: You are on the boot screen. Travelling away from it hangs the game - press Proceed to reach the main menu first, then open levels from there.

launch.description: Voices of the Void builds a save slot before it opens a level, and a plain `open` skips that (most maps then spawn props without end). This drives the game's own Sandbox screen: it opens it, selects a slot and presses Apply, with only the level swapped. It uses a copy of your 'first' slot folder (toolkit_sandbox), so your own saves are not touched.
